name: Playwright
description: Playwright's own MCP server, run on the machine Polyth runs on. It gives the agent a browser it can actually operate, which is different from reading a page: forms, signed-out public sites and visual checks. It needs Node.js and downloads a browser on first start.

probe.note: The invocation comes from the vendor README; the version is the one npm published on 2026-11-06 (registry.npmjs.org/@playwright/mcp/latest = 0.0.84). The catalog never starts it unpinned.
